g.text: Figure 6 | HyperSpatial-MAP generalizes to 2D human spatial transcriptomics
External atlas adaptation across species, platform, tissue and spatial dimension without target-specific tuning

External 2D generalization, not new method tuning. Six section pairs are paired generalization units; three donors are biological sources. Spots and genes are not biological replicates. Conclusions are limited to the demonstrated settings.
